summary: Iteration 7 testing completed for DCLIC Informatique Auth JWT + RGPD features. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All auth and RGPD features working correctly including login/logout, ProtectedRoute, privacy policy page, and signature page with RGPD section.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout is IP-specific. In load-balanced environments, requests may come from different IPs, making lockout less effective. This is expected behavior but worth noting.

passed_tests: BACKEND POST /api/auth/login: valid credentials return {access_token, token_type: 'bearer', user: {id, email, name}}
BACKEND POST /api/auth/login: invalid password returns 401 'Identifiant ou mot de passe incorrect'
BACKEND POST /api/auth/login: non-existent email returns 401
BACKEND POST /api/auth/login: empty credentials return 401
BACKEND POST /api/auth/login: brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts (IP-specific)
BACKEND GET /api/auth/me: without Authorization header returns 401
BACKEND GET /api/auth/me: with invalid token returns 401
BACKEND GET /api/auth/me: with valid Bearer token returns {id, email, name}
BACKEND GET /api/privacy-policy: returns {title: 'Politique de confidentialité', sections: [8 sections]}
BACKEND GET /api/reparations/{id}/public: conditions contain 'donnees_personnelles' key
BACKEND CONDITIONS_REPARATION: has all 9 keys including donnees_personnelles
BACKEND admin seeding: admin user exists and can login with configured credentials
BACKEND public routes: /api/privacy-policy, /api/auth/login, /api/ipad/current, /api/suivi/* accessible without auth
FRONTEND /login: page shows DCLIC INFORMATIQUE title, 'Espace technicien' subtitle, email/password inputs, eye button for password visibility, 'Se connecter' button
FRONTEND /login: invalid credentials show toast 'Identifiant ou mot de passe incorrect'
FRONTEND /login: valid credentials redirect to / with sidebar visible and 'Connexion réussie' toast
FRONTEND auth persistence: token stored in localStorage, session persists after page reload
FRONTEND ProtectedRoute: accessing /reparations without auth redirects to /login
FRONTEND header PC: user menu dropdown shows email and 'Se déconnecter' button
FRONTEND logout: clears localStorage and redirects to /login on protected route access
FRONTEND /signer/:id: 'Données personnelles (RGPD)' section visible in conditions list
FRONTEND /signer/:id: 'En signant, vous acceptez les conditions de réparation et la politique de confidentialité' text with clickable link to /confidentialite (data-testid='privacy-link')
FRONTEND /confidentialite: public page with 8 sections, 'Retour' link to /ipad, accessible without auth
FRONTEND public routes: /ipad, /signer/:id, /suivi/:id, /confidentialite accessible without token
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded automatically at backend startup via seed_admin_user()
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth JWT + RGPD features fully implemented and tested: 1) Login page at /login with email/password, eye button for password visibility, 'Se connecter' button. 2) JWT token stored in localStorage (dclic_token, dclic_user). 3) ProtectedRoute redirects to /login if not authenticated. 4) User menu in PC header with email and logout button. 5) Brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts (IP:email specific, 15 min lockout). 6) Privacy policy page at /confidentialite with 8 RGPD sections. 7) Signature page shows 'donnees_personnelles' condition and privacy link. 8) Public routes (/ipad, /signer, /suivi, /confidentialite, /login) accessible without auth.
